company.name: VenoStent
company.shortDescription: VenoStent is a tissue engineering medical device company developing bioabsorbable polymer wraps for better outcomes in vascular surgery.
company.description: VenoStent is a clinical-stage tissue engineering company that’s developed tunable, bioabsorbable smart polymer wraps in order to fundamentally transform the 5 million vascular surgeries performed each year. The company's technology is made from a new class of shape-memory polymers that are primarily used as an external stent in coronary artery bypass surgery and do not require sutures, allowing doctors to reduce surgery time, infection risk, and wound resuming in hemodialysis patients while also reducing failure from vein occlusion.

productsAndServices.description: A bioabsorbable, flexible vascular wrap designed to reduce failures at dialysis access sites in vascular surgery.
productsAndServices.name: SelfWrap

aiResearchSummary.text: VenoStent is engaged in research and development of shape memory polymer devices that are porous, as described in 'Polymeric vascular grafts which induce neovascularization with mild to minimal...'. These devices feature specific pore sizes and spacing to promote neovascularization, reduce inflammation, and decrease fibrosis, aligning with the company's focus on bioabsorbable polymer wraps for improved vascular surgery outcomes. Their R&D centers on optimizing polymeric vascular grafts for surgical applications.
